hypothesis: Four output rows per block may amortize routed-MMVQ setup and activation loads while retaining gate/up/shared-expert fusion
candidate_scope: Only sm_121, IQ3_S/IQ4_NL, four routed tokens and output-row counts divisible by four. All other cases keep two rows per block.
runtime: Isolated matched copies of the installed b11756 plus 30380 and 30640 runtime; only the candidate CUDA DLL differs

correctness.serialized_cases: 22 existing corrected routed cases plus 12 row-boundary/broadcast cases
correctness.shared_fusion: Extend the existing MUL_MAT_ID_SHARED test type list with IQ3_S/IQ4_NL; six token widths per type, including four
correctness.dispatch: Clean traces must show four-row fused and unfused kernels, and two-row fallback on neighboring non-divisible row counts

operator_screen.cases: Two original-model 512-expert layouts at four tokens and two existing four-token shared/gate-fusion cases
operator_screen.meaning: Repeated same-tensor cache-reuse diagnostic, not a model-speed or physical-bandwidth measurement

actual_mtp_if_operator_gate_passes: Original Rust/JSON cases, two warmed samples per arm, >=3% per-case gain and nonoverlapping ranges, reverse order only after the first pair passes, 600-second total screen budget
stop_rule: One row-tile candidate only. Stop at the first failed gate; no row-count, type-subset or token-cutoff sweep.
